## Actual experiment
Normalize each mesh height to .98 and bbox center to origin. Voxelize by subdividing surface with pitch .009 on shared 148^3 grid, origin [-.66,-.66,-.66]; binary close 2 iterations, fill holes, open 1 iteration, retain largest connected component. Compute signed distance EDT inside minus outside, times pitch. Occupancy volumes .27883521/.285765813, voxel IoU .805284713. Test (1) equal SDF average, (2) smoothly regional weighted average with Hunyuan weight .5+.35*exp(-((X/.31)^2+((Y-.25)/.22)^2+((Z-.32)/.26)^2))-.25/(1+exp((Y+.34)/.035)), clipped to 0..1, (3) same regional field Gaussian sigma 1.7. Extract real 0-isosurface marching cubes, fix normals, project source front RGB by adaptive scanlines with alpha, front-facing normal and depth mask; base cream [.86,.78,.67]. Export and reimport actual native GLBs, not SVG or primitive assembly. No new neural inference claimed.
